what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from France in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 455 French asylum seekers, and Canada hosted 44.6% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are the United States, Brazil and Peru.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for France, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 45 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 608, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
